mr_title: Accepted str or bytes for password and salt in password hashers.

expected_issues.title: force_str() on bytes passwords fails for non-UTF-8 input
expected_issues.description:
force_str() on a bytes password raises UnicodeDecodeError for valid non-UTF-8 byte passwords in the PBKDF2 hasher (and the MD5 hasher), although the change claims to accept bytes.

The change advertises str-or-bytes support, but PBKDF2PasswordHasher.encode() decodes the password with force_str() before hashing, and MD5PasswordHasher decodes both salt and password. Any bytes password that is not valid UTF-8 now raises UnicodeDecodeError instead of being hashed; hashing functions should use force_bytes() and never decode the secret.
